annotations.title: Set a rank tracker keyword's target URL

description: Sets or clears the URL you intend to rank for a tracked keyword. Feeds list_rank_cannibalisation — set this for the keywords you care about, then check for a mismatch after the next run. FREE: database only, no SEO data provider is called and no credits are spent.

configId.description: Rank tracker config ID. Call get_rank_tracker without a trackerId to list the project's trackers and their IDs.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

targetUrl.description: Absolute http(s) URL you intend to rank for this keyword, or null to clear a previously-set one.

trackingKeywordId.description: The tracked keyword's own row ID (from the rank tracker's keyword rows), not the keyword text.

name: set_rank_keyword_target_url
